name: mirage
text: Findings (full write-up: research/tracker_on_github_2026-11-16.md). Novig can supply every order and fill (price, size, fee, maker or taker), the money ledger with settlement payouts, and open positions, for hand bets and engine bets alike. From that GitHub can compute day-by-day profit, per-bet results and wallet P/L. Novig can't supply the EV and fair price at the moment you bet, the rules behind a bet, stars, or the closing line and CLV. GitHub has to compute and keep those, and for hand bets the phone would send a tiny bet-time record. So the engine can build the whole Tracker file on GitHub, and the phone only shows it and keeps open bets. Not yet verified: how far back Novig's history goes, and the real settlement row shape (never seen live). My plan: build it on the engine, compare its totals with the phone's for a week, then shrink the phone's file to open bets. Say go and I'll start with the engine reading the history.
